paragraphs.text: Coralhelm is a floating waterfall city on the continent of Tazeem on Zendikar , and the new capital of the plane's merfolk .

Built during the Battle for Zendikar , Coralhelm is a young settlement founded by Noyan Dar after the original merfolk Enclave — an island city of pale stone and sparkling crystals — was destroyed by the Eldrazi . Once a masterpiece of merfolk civilization, the old Enclave now lies in ruin.

Located upriver in the Umara Gorge near its mouth above Halimar , Coralhelm Refuge is built inside a cluster of enormous floating conch shells, held in place by a complex network of nets and lines spanning the gorge walls. Curtains of falling water cascade around the settlement, while suspended bridges link the conch shelters to rocky islets.

Noyan Dar, now the Coralhelm Commander, leads the refuge as both lullmage and scholar. Coralhelm has become a sanctuary for merfolk refugees from across Zendikar and relies on trade with human merchants and inland elves for essential goods.
